description: Ask before osxphotos commands that write to the Photos library, and log every osxphotos write for an audit trail.

hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null || true); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE 'osxphotos[[:space:]]+(import|batch-edit|timewarp|push-exif|sync|add-locations|orphans[[:space:]].*--import|keywords?[[:space:]]+.*--(add|remove))'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "ask", "permissionDecisionReason": "apple-photos: this osxphotos command modifies the Photos library. Confirm a backup exists first."}}'; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null || true); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE 'osxphotos[[:space:]]+(import|export|batch-edit|timewarp|push-exif|sync|add-locations)'; then printf '[%s] apple-photos osxphotos write: %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | head -c 200 | tr -d '\n')" >> "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/apple_photos_audit.log" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
